Key Skills    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities  Excellent written and verbal communication skills  Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities  Proficiency in data and process modeling techniques  Experience with project management methodologies (SCRUM, Kaizen)  Attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented approach  Deep SAP S/4HANA Procurement and MM configuration skills  Cross-module integration expertise  User training, documentation, and workshop facilitation    Qualification & experience   Qualifications & Experience    Qualifications:   Bachelor's degree in Computer Software Engineering or related field. SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP MM and Ariba certifications are strongly preferred.   Experience:    10+ years in SAP MM, WM, and Supply Chain roles  Minimum 5+ years in S/4HANA implementations and upgrades  Proven experience in Oil & Gas, Energy, or large industrial sectors  Experience leading global template rollouts and cross-functional teams    Language Requirement:   Fluent in English (written and spoken)  About Company    Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is an Australian proprietary company limited by shares, registered with the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ACN 664 795 902) in New South Wales since January 2023.
